entities.summary: Basem Khandakji is a Palestinian writer who was born in 1983. When he was 20, he was convicted in his role in helping to kill three people. His novel, written while in prison, A Mask, the Color of the Sky won the Arabic Booker Prize in 2024. Basem Khandakji was a authors & novelists from Nablus (b. 1983-12-22, Nablus).
